ex.en: You have the advantage of a good education.
ex.zh: 你受過良好教育，這是你的優勢。

ex.en: His parents are saving for his college education.
ex.zh: 他的父母在為他的大學教育存錢。

ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
ex.zh: 他強調了教育的重要性。

education.en: the process of teaching and learning, usually in a school

ex.en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
ex.zh: 側邊欄顯示在頁面邊緣、網站標誌下方。

ex.en: Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
ex.zh: 不要站得離懸崖邊太近。

ex.en: He sat on the edge of the bed.
ex.zh: 他坐在床邊。

edge.en: the outside part of something, where it ends

ex.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
ex.zh: 如果系統工程師繼續離職，公司的競爭優勢就會被削弱。

ex.en: Who has the edge now?
ex.zh: 現在誰佔上風？

ex.en: You don't want to be an editor?
ex.zh: 你不想當編輯嗎？

ex.en: She works as an editor at a publishing company.
ex.zh: 她在出版社當編輯。

editor.en: a person whose job is to check and improve writing before it is published

ex.en: I write code in a simple text editor.
ex.zh: 我用簡單的文字編輯器寫程式。

ex.en: This photo editor is free to download.
ex.zh: 這款照片編輯軟體可以免費下載。

editor.en: a computer program used to write or change files

ex.en: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
ex.zh: 他提議改革教育制度。

ex.en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.
ex.zh: 每個孩子都應該享有相同的教育機會。

ex.en: I found the field trip very educational.
ex.zh: 我覺得這次校外教學很有教育意義。

ex.en: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
ex.zh: 有人說電視卡通本身就有教育意義。

ex.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.
ex.zh: 現在的人教育程度比以前高。

ex.en: Mr. Ito is a highly educated man.
ex.zh: 伊藤先生是個受過高等教育的人。

ex.en: He is proud of having been educated in the United States.
ex.zh: 他以自己在美國受教育為傲。

educate.en: to teach someone, usually at a school

ex.en: We need to educate the public about recycling.
ex.zh: 我們需要向大眾宣導資源回收。

ex.en: The campaign aims to educate customers about online safety.
ex.zh: 這項活動旨在讓顧客了解網路安全。

educate.en: to give people information about something important

ex.en: Is there a paperback edition of this book?
ex.zh: 這本書有平裝版嗎？

ex.en: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
ex.zh: 第一版和第二版，哪一個比較完整？

ex.en: The latest edition of the magazine comes out tomorrow.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌的最新一期明天出刊。

edition.en: a version of a book or newspaper printed at one time

ex.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
ex.zh: 交出去之前把你的作品好好修改一下，太馬虎了。

ex.en: It will be able to edit the pictures you don't like, then print them out.
ex.zh: 它可以修改你不喜歡的照片，然後印出來。

ex.en: Can you edit this video before we post it?
ex.zh: 我們發布前，你可以先剪輯這支影片嗎？

edit.en: to change and improve a piece of writing, film or recording

ex.en: He was a great educator so his children really listened to him.
ex.zh: 他很會教育人，所以他的孩子都很聽話。

ex.en: She has worked as an educator for thirty years.
ex.zh: 她從事教育工作已經三十年。

educator.en: a person whose job is to teach or help people learn

ex.en: Today's editorial criticizes the new tax.
ex.zh: 今天的社論批評新稅制。

ex.en: She writes editorials for a local paper.
ex.zh: 她為一家地方報紙撰寫社論。

editorial.en: an article in a newspaper that gives the opinion of the editors

ex.en: Bill is on the editorial staff.
ex.zh: 比爾在編輯部工作。

ex.en: The magazine has a small editorial team.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌的編輯團隊很小。

editorial.en: relating to the work of preparing writing for publication

ex.en: Edward is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 愛德華是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Edward plays chess with his grandfather every weekend.
ex.zh: 愛德華每個週末都和爺爺下西洋棋。

ex.en: The teacher called Edward to answer the question.
ex.zh: 老師叫愛德華回答問題。

ex.en: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland.
ex.zh: 愛丁堡是蘇格蘭的首府。

ex.en: Edinburgh Castle sits on top of a large hill in the city.
ex.zh: 愛丁堡城堡坐落在市區一座大山丘上。

ex.en: Eddie waters the plants in the office every Friday.
ex.zh: 埃迪每週五都會幫辦公室的植物澆水。

ex.en: Eddie lent me his notes before the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前埃迪把他的筆記借給了我。

ex.en: She is an educated woman who speaks four languages.
ex.zh: 她是一位受過良好教育的女性，會說四種語言。

ex.en: Educated people usually find it easier to get a good job.
ex.zh: 受過教育的人通常比較容易找到好工作。

ex.en: Edmund is a traditional English name for boys.
ex.zh: 艾德蒙是傳統的英文男孩名字。

ex.en: My neighbor's son, Edmund, plays the violin.
ex.zh: 我鄰居的兒子艾德蒙會拉小提琴。

ex.en: According to the story, Adam and Eve lived in the Garden of Eden.
ex.zh: 根據故事，亞當與夏娃住在伊甸園裡。

ex.en: The little island felt like an Eden to the tired travelers.
ex.zh: 對疲憊的旅人來說，這座小島像一座樂園。

ex.en: The museum has a room furnished in Edwardian style.
ex.zh: 博物館裡有一間以愛德華時代風格佈置的房間。

ex.en: She loves Edwardian dresses with lace collars.
ex.zh: 她很喜歡有蕾絲領子的愛德華時代風洋裝。

ex.en: Video editing takes a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 影片剪輯需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: The book needs more editing before it is published.
ex.zh: 這本書在出版前還需要更多的編輯修改。

ex.en: He is editing his essay before handing it in.
ex.zh: 他正在修改論文，準備交出去。

ex.en: She spends her evenings editing photos from the trip.
ex.zh: 她晚上都在修那些旅行的照片。

ex.en: These berries are edible, but those are poisonous.
ex.zh: 這些莓果可以吃，但那些有毒。

ex.en: The cake was decorated with edible flowers.
ex.zh: 蛋糕上用可食用的花朵裝飾。

ex.en: He felt edgy before the big exam.
ex.zh: 大考前他覺得很緊繃不安。

ex.en: Too much coffee makes me edgy.
ex.zh: 咖啡喝太多會讓我煩躁不安。

ex.en: The designer is known for her edgy style.
ex.zh: 這位設計師以前衛大膽的風格聞名。

ex.en: It's an edgy comedy that not everyone will enjoy.
ex.zh: 這是一部風格大膽的喜劇，不是每個人都會喜歡。

ex.en: The old bank is a grand stone edifice in the city center.
ex.zh: 那間老銀行是市中心一棟宏偉的石造建築。

ex.en: The tourists admired the towering edifice.
ex.zh: 遊客讚嘆那棟高聳的大建築。

ex.en: The king issued an edict banning the festival.
ex.zh: 國王頒布了禁止這個節慶的法令。

ex.en: Citizens had to obey the edict or pay a fine.
ex.zh: 市民必須遵守這項法令，否則要罰款。

ex.en: The educationalist gave a talk about how children learn best.
ex.zh: 這位教育學者演講談孩子如何學得最好。

ex.en: Many educationalists believe that play is important for young children.
ex.zh: 許多教育學者認為遊戲對幼兒很重要。

ex.en: A small eddy formed behind the rock in the stream.
ex.zh: 溪裡的岩石後面形成了一個小漩渦。

ex.en: Leaves spun slowly in the eddy near the bank.
ex.zh: 葉子在岸邊的漩渦中慢慢打轉。

ex.en: The water eddied around the bridge posts.
ex.zh: 水在橋墩周圍打著漩渦。

ex.en: Dust eddied in the corner of the empty room.
ex.zh: 灰塵在空房間的角落裡打轉。

ex.en: The game is fun and educationally useful for young kids.
ex.zh: 這個遊戲很好玩，對年幼的孩子在教育上也很有幫助。

ex.en: Educationally, the school has a very strong record.
ex.zh: 在教育方面，這所學校的紀錄非常出色。
